description: This Kotlin source file defines the TvAboutActivity class, which is an Android Activity used for displaying an about screen on a TV interface. It manages UI elements such as a title and back button, handles key events (specifically the back key), and navigates back to the index activity.

classes.name: TvAboutActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that displays an 'About' screen for TV, handles navigation via a back button or back key press, and manages focus for remote control navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, associates UI elements, and sets focus and click listeners.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides key event handling to intercept the back key and navigate back to the index activity.

methods.name: backToIndex
methods.description: Starts the TvIndexActivity with the intent flag to clear the activity stack and finishes the current activity.
